title: Constraint Preferences: Inattention and Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2606.11600v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study robust decision problems when individuals have maxmin preferences whose belief sets are neighborhoods around reference models, commonly known as "constraint preferences." We first show that a more disciplined form of rationally inattentive behavior is equivalent to the behavior implied by a subclass of constraint preferences. We then introduce an aggregation principle that requires collective beliefs to satisfy every individual's constraint. This requirement links collective beliefs to the information-processing technologies that generate individual constraints. Applications reveal how these technologies determine asset prices, when prediction-market prices become self-confirming, and how much dynamic mechanisms can reduce information rents.

translated_title: 约束偏好：不注意与聚合
translated_abstract: 我们研究个体具有最大最小偏好时的鲁棒决策问题，其信念集合是围绕参考模型的邻域，通常称为“约束偏好”。我们首先证明了一种更规范的理性不注意行为等价于约束偏好某个子类所蕴含的行为。然后，我们引入了一个聚合原则，要求集体信念满足每个个体的约束。这一要求将集体信念与产生个体约束的信息处理技术联系起来。应用分析揭示了这些技术如何决定资产价格、预测市场价格何时变得自我确认，以及动态机制能在多大程度上减少信息租金。
tldr: 本文证明了理性不注意行为与约束偏好子类之间的等价性，并提出聚合原则将集体信念与信息处理技术相联系，据此解释了资产定价、预测市场自我确认价格以及动态机制减少信息租金等问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the equivalence between a disciplined form of rational inattention and a subclass of constraint preferences, and introduces an aggregation principle linking collective beliefs to information-processing technologies, with applications to asset pricing, self-confirming prediction-market prices, and the reduction of information rents by dynamic mechanisms.
